I had to visit again and again, but every time the owner just said “come tomorrow.” When I asked about it, the owner told me they only give 7 days guarantee after servicing. But my bike started showing the same issue within 2–3 days, and again after 4–5 days. This kind of response and careless attitude is very disappointing. The owner really needs to understand how to provide proper service.
